question: By whose agency does the speaker come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of the Kaulas.
The speaker claims to have become known or to have come to know through grace.
That knowledge is identified as the determination of the Kaula teaching.
inference: By the grace of the lord of the Kaulas, the speaker has come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
uncertainties: The exact sense of jñātaḥ here is ambiguous between 'known' and 'made known'.
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
